message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: The defendant was a school cashier, used position to embezzle public funds (public money) 332,600 yuan, stored in his bank card, used to buy stocks. He later returned the money. He confessed.

The crime is "挪用公款" which under Chinese criminal law is "挪用公款罪" (Embezzlement of public funds). Also possibly "职务侵占" but that's for state employees? Actually "挪用公款罪" is for public officials who misappropriate public funds. So the appropriate charge: "挪用公款罪". Also maybe "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribes. He just misappropriated. So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>.

Check format: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa> or with 罪? The example: "受贿". So just the name. Use "挪用公款罪". Provide exactly.

Thus final.
